resources.string: Transfer YouTube subscriptions and playlists using FreeTube .db or JSON files.

Import a FreeTube subscriptions or playlists export after reviewing its contents. Existing data is kept. Imports go into the profile shown in the preview; FreeTube profiles become subscription groups. Exports include YouTube subscriptions or local playlists from your current WizeStream profile. Other services and local files are skipped.
Import into profile “%1$s”. Skipped unsupported records: %2$d.
Select a valid FreeTube subscriptions or playlists export, up to 16 MiB.
Imported %1$d items. Skipped %2$d duplicate or unsupported items.
Could not import the file. Existing data was kept.
Export complete. Skipped %1$d items unsupported by FreeTube.
Could not write the FreeTube export.
